result.title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform
result.summary: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). Additional features include centralized control of an agent group through a single EMIP agent client, collaborative object transportation by multiple agents, and experimental support functions such as recording and retrieving observation histories. By integrating these features into a reusable platform, EMIP aims to support research on human-human, human-agent, and agent-agent cooperation under different participant configurations and agent control methods. Usage examples illustrate concurrent speech and physical action, task coordination, and overlapping speech. The source code for the platform is publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/AI-Humans-Lab/EMIP-Embodied-Multi-Party-Interaction-Platform).

AI.brief_summary: 提出基于 Minecraft 的多方具身交互平台 EMIP，支持多人多智能体在同一虚拟环境中进行全双工语音交流与并行物理操作，并提供 MCP 接口、集中式智能体控制与实验记录功能。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于交互环境与工程基础设施，未涉及视觉推理的内部表示、latent 状态生成、证据筛选或训练监督，仅可作评测载体，缺少具体可借鉴的方法线索。
